name: Davis Keller Gallery
about_text: Davis Keller is a contemporary art gallery and studio management firm based in Downtown Los Angeles. Co-founded by Sarah Davis and Rachel Keller, the gallery pairs studio management and business mentorship for artists with exhibition and advisory services for collectors. It stages shows in its Los Angeles space intended to help artists build income and collector relationships, while also offering artwork placement and art advisory services that emphasize direct, ongoing relationships between collectors and contemporary artists. The gallery is currently open to visitors by appointment only.
